PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=services/desk-gateway/src python3 - <<'PY'
from desk_gateway.quantum_teleportation import BellPairPool, BellStateType, EntanglementPurifier, QuantumRepeaterMesh, QuantumTeleportationProtocol
from desk_gateway.quantum_qkd_mesh import QuantumTeleportationAnchorExporter, QuantumTeleportationReceiptLedger, QKDProtocolEngine, EavesdropDetector
pool=BellPairPool()
pair=pool.create_pair('alice','bob',BellStateType.PHI_PLUS,.90)
ok,purified,_=EntanglementPurifier.purify(pair,pair)
print({'same_pair_distillation_accepted':ok and purified is not None})
pair=pool.create_pair('alice','bob',BellStateType.PHI_MINUS,.90)
protocol=QuantumTeleportationProtocol(QuantumRepeaterMesh(pool))
first=protocol.teleport_qubit('wrong-source','wrong-target',1+0j,1j,bell_pair=pair)
second=protocol.teleport_qubit('wrong-source','wrong-target',1+0j,1j,bell_pair=pair)
print({'fidelity':first.fidelity,'required_fidelity':.95,'below_threshold_reported_success':first.success,'consumed_pair_reuse_accepted':second.success,'wrong_endpoints_accepted':first.success})
engine=QKDProtocolEngine()
for name,call in [('bb84',lambda:engine.run_bb84_exchange('a','b',bit_length=0)),('e91',lambda:engine.run_e91_exchange('a','b',pair_count=0))]:
    try:
        call()
    except Exception as exc:
        print({'empty_exchange':name,'exception':type(exc).__name__})
ledger=QuantumTeleportationReceiptLedger()
ledger.append_event('DIAGNOSTIC',['alice','bob'],'audit-session',.90,{'audit':True})
anchor=QuantumTeleportationAnchorExporter('http://127.0.0.1:1').export_commitment(ledger)
print({'unreachable_rpc_reported_confirmed':anchor['status']=='confirmed','reported_slot':anchor['slot'],'transaction_identifier_length':len(anchor['commitment_tx'])})
print({'qber_at_limit_aborts':EavesdropDetector.evaluate_eavesdropping(.11),'qber_above_limit_aborts':EavesdropDetector.evaluate_eavesdropping(.110001)})
